title: MHT-CET Chemistry
summary: MHT-CET Chemistry past questions from 68 shifts, 2021 to 2026, five a day. Questions asked again in another shift and the question types that keep coming back come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across years: the bank keeps one row for a question that several sets of one year shared. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF.md) and checked.
